tests.label: Installed DEV build
tests.instructions: Confirm the installed TU version matches the target release. This checks only the visible version label.

tests.label: Ten integrated tools registered
tests.instructions: Read the shared TU API and confirm all ten expected tools are registered; Stock and Calculations must be absent. Registration does not prove a tool works.

tests.label: Temporary storage roundtrip
tests.instructions: Write, read and remove only a temporary TU Test key; do not touch tool data.

tests.label: Published single-script DEV artifact
tests.instructions: Check release metadata, ten bundled factory markers, removed tool exclusion and DEV-only backend URLs. This is a source check, not runtime validation.

tests.label: GitHub published agreement
tests.instructions: Read the small published DEV agreement version.json metadata file. Full agreement text is not fetched by this automatic check.

tests.label: DEV Worker published agreement
tests.instructions: Ask the authenticated TU Manager for a read-only DEV agreement-status check. Confirm its published version; the tool does not receive keys/tokens or download full text. If authentication is unavailable, mark BLOCKED.

tests.label: Agreement version consistency
tests.instructions: Compare the published agreement_version values only. Wording, number and effective-date fields are not compared for this verification. Full agreement remains available for user review in TU.

tests.label: Public Only registration
tests.instructions: In DEV, register using a Public Only key. Verify the server-confirmed access label and accepted current agreement. Record outcome only; never paste the key.

tests.label: Limited Access registration
tests.instructions: Repeat with a Limited Access key in DEV; verify its label and access to the features requiring that level.

tests.label: Reject unsupported or invalid keys
tests.instructions: Verify Full Access, unsupported levels and invalid keys are rejected with actionable errors and are not persisted.

tests.label: Saved keys and verified per-key labels
tests.instructions: Save at least two Public Only and two Limited Access keys. Verify each is listed once with its own Torn-verified access level and owner, even after reload. Adding a key must leave the current login unchanged. Recheck legacy keys; explicitly switch the login and War Organizer key, and verify other keys remain saved.

tests.label: Remove one key without losing others
tests.instructions: Remove an inactive key and verify every copy is removed while other keys and the login remain. Remove the active login in a dedicated DEV session: cancellation must be confirmed before deletion, other saved keys must remain, and the deleted key must not return after reload through GM or legacy storage. Cancellation/network failure must retain the active key.

tests.label: Show / Hide API key
tests.instructions: Check registration and Settings fields toggle between masked and visible values without exposing values in reports.

tests.label: Session and agreement persistence
tests.instructions: Accept the current agreement, navigate and reload Torn; authorization restores without another acceptance prompt. With a fresh session cache, verify no repeated key/profile or full agreement downloads. After the five-minute verification cache expires, confirm a metadata status check on activity/resume. Closing the host may require normal session restoration.

tests.label: Expired session renewal
tests.instructions: Use a controlled DEV session to verify expired tokens renew once through the Manager, backend revocation stops access, cross-tab logout clears cached access, and changed agreement versions require explicit acceptance. TU Test read-only version checking must never register or accept automatically.

tests.label: Authentication failure recovery
tests.instructions: Verify rejected/revoked keys, rate limits and network failures produce clear recovery steps without repeated requests or prompts.

tests.label: Complete published agreement
tests.instructions: Compare all displayed content plus version, number and effective date with the published DEV agreement.

tests.label: Agreement acceptance record
tests.instructions: After explicitly accepting in DEV, inspect an authorized backend response or event record confirming the acceptance event for the current agreement. Record the event type, agreement version and confirmation timestamp without credentials. Successful UI access alone does not pass this check; mark BLOCKED if backend evidence is unavailable. This tool never submits acceptance.

tests.label: Cancellation and revocation
tests.instructions: In a dedicated DEV session, cancel acceptance and confirm backend event/revocation, tool access removal and a subsequent valid recovery.

tests.label: Version-change reacceptance
tests.instructions: With an approved controlled DEV agreement update, verify old acceptance no longer grants access. Do not modify production or publish terms just to complete this checklist.

tests.label: Credentials stay private
tests.instructions: Inspect diagnostics, exported backups/reports and console output. Confirm no API keys, bearer tokens or room secrets appear; record no secret values.

tests.label: Tools / Settings / About
tests.instructions: Open each tab, Business Tools, Games single/multiplayer, Chat Tools and War Tools. War Organizer belongs under War Tools. No module installation/catalog controls or removed tools.

tests.label: Approved gold logo
tests.instructions: Check the approved no-flare Integrated Gold master in launcher, headers and War Organizer on standard/high-density displays. Check sharpness, proportions, transparent exterior and compact launcher size.

tests.label: Launcher visibility and dragging
tests.instructions: Drag with mouse and touch as applicable; reload to verify position persistence, keep launcher on-screen after rotation/resize.

tests.label: Window navigation and layout
tests.instructions: Check Back, Minimize, Restore and Exit, drag/resize, saved positions, viewport bounds, stacking, scrolling and overflow.

tests.label: Lazy startup and cleanup
tests.instructions: With Manager and tools closed, verify no authorization polling interval, connected Manager DOM observers or background tool initialization. Opening a tool should initialize only that tool; Torn page-content observers should exist only for activated tools that need them. Repeat close/Exit/switch and verify observers/timers stop. Minimizing an active monitor may preserve its intended monitoring.

tests.label: Reload and duplicate injection
tests.instructions: Reload and test normal Torn SPA navigation; verify one launcher and one instance per tool with no startup exceptions.

tests.label: Native host / request bridges
tests.instructions: In the selected actual host, exercise its real GM legacy/modern or PDA/fetch bridge and isolated/shared page context. A mocked or desktop-browser result cannot prove PDA compatibility.

tests.label: Settings persistence
tests.instructions: Change time display and tool settings; reload and verify saved values and unaffected historical data.

tests.label: Backup and restoration
tests.instructions: Export TU-managed data and restore in a controlled DEV profile; verify additive restoration and key exclusion. Separately export/import large archives and legacy data using each tool.

tests.label: Single-script update
tests.instructions: Install/update via rolling DEV URL; confirm version, all ten tools, settings/history, approved logo, and no separate tool installation.

tests.label: Rollback procedure
tests.instructions: In a controlled DEV profile, disable the integrated script and restore the previous Manager/tools without clearing storage. Confirm recovery; then return to the target DEV build.

tests.label: Flight Game — functional test
tests.instructions: Play with mouse/keyboard and touch as applicable; check graphics, audio, scoring, pause/end, condition transitions, saved game and restore.

tests.label: Flight Game — lifecycle and saved data
tests.instructions: Open, minimize, restore, Back, Exit, switch away and reopen this tool repeatedly. Check viewport/scroll/touch behavior, one instance, saved data and cessation of polling/listeners after Exit. Verify no late errors or duplicate requests.
